questions.stem: A 55-year-old man presents to the emergency department with a 2-day history of asymptomatic, non-scaly, red macular lesions predominantly involving both lower extremities. The patient denies any recent infections or medication changes. The attending dermatologist decides to perform a bedside test to help differentiate the nature of these red lesions. Which of the following tests is most appropriate for evaluating these red skin lesions?
